DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN) secondary to antibiotic allergy.

The presence of binucleated eosinophilic cells in the urine, combined with elevated creatinine and flank pain shortly after starting antibiotics, strongly suggests an allergic reaction to the medication. Have you noticed any new rash, hives, or generalized itching since the antibiotics were prescribed?
